evals.name: bundled-dbl-submit
evals.prompt: clicking Log in on my localhost is submitting the form twice to my backend — i'm seeing double login attempts in the server logs per click. please investigate and plan a fix. dev-browser is connected.
evals.expected_root_cause: the submit handler is registered on the form twice during bundle init (two separate setup calls each call addEventListener('submit', ...) with the same handler), so each user submit triggers two fetch POSTs
evals.expected_fix_location: bundle.js — remove the duplicate addEventListener registration so only one submit handler is bound

evals.name: bundled-stale-index
evals.prompt: my todo app's 'Remove last' button on localhost is broken — after i add new items, clicking Remove last removes some older item instead of the one i just added. please investigate.
evals.expected_root_cause: the 'remove last' click handler captures the index of the last item at page init time (stored in a variable that is never recomputed) and always splices at that fixed index, so after items are added, it keeps removing the item at the original last position instead of the current last
evals.expected_fix_location: bundle.js — compute the last-index inside the click handler (items.length - 1 at click time) rather than capturing it once at init

evals.name: bundled-throttle
evals.prompt: my Buy button on localhost is supposed to be rate-limited to once per second to prevent accidental duplicate orders, but rapid clicks still all go through and hit the backend. figure out what's going on.
evals.expected_root_cause: the throttle helper resets its 'ready' flag via setTimeout with a 0ms delay instead of using the configured wait interval, so the flag flips back to true almost immediately and every click passes through
evals.expected_fix_location: bundle.js throttle helper — use the wait argument as the setTimeout delay instead of 0
